build_multiview_pipeline: build a MultiViewPipeline to process multi-view images with depth, ray directions, and NeRF target views for 3D detection
create_global_alignment: create a GlobalAlignment pipeline to rotate and translate 3D scene points using an axis alignment matrix
test_kitti_random_flip: test the KittiRandomFlip pipeline to apply horizontal flipping to KITTI 3D bounding boxes and camera extrinsics
refactor_random_shift_origin: refactor the RandomShiftOrigin pipeline to add Gaussian noise to the lidar2img origin for data augmentation
review_sunrgbd_set_origin: review the SunRgbdSetOrigin pipeline to compute and set the 3D origin from camera intrinsic and extrinsic matrices
